clue.text: Sport that doesn't amount to anything?

definitions.text: Sport that doesn't amount to anything?

parts.words: Sport that doesn't amount to anything?
parts.note: split the Japanese wrestling sport as SUM plus O: an amount coming to nothing, the zero shape

explanation.definitionFit: Japanese heavyweight wrestling is a national sport, the example the clue points at.

clue.text: Wood, part of table, one turns beautifully in Canada

clue.text: Fish with extra length always caught

clue.text: Result half decided, officer interrupting gambling game firmly closed pot

clue.text: Author announced "A Dish in Delhi"

clue.text: Miles, without thinking, follows lifting computer stuff, like a mouse

clue.text: Being stuck, I follow secretary's initiative?
